The first sync starts at once. The project is created if it has no files yet.

post.summary: Accept an invitation, and work in its workspace
post.description: Signed in, the invitation must be for the user's email. Not signed in, it makes the invited email's account from `name` and `password`, and signs in (setting the session cookie); an email that has an account signs in first. Works even with `SIGNUP_ENABLED` off.

post.summary: Email a link to choose a new password
post.description: Always answers `202`, whether the address has an account or not, so it tells nobody which do. With `SMTP_HOST` set, the account gets a link that works once, for an hour; at most one a minute is sent. Without email, operators make a link with `ragolex users reset-password`.

post.summary: Choose a new password with a reset link
post.description: Every session of the account ends; sign in with the new password.

put.description: Needs the current password; a wrong one counts as a failed sign-in. The user's other sessions end; this one stays.

syncing.description: Whether a worker is syncing it now.

next_sync_at.title: Next Sync At
next_sync_at.description: When it is next due; null when it is synced only when asked.

last_error.title: Last Error
last_error.description: Why the last sync could not crawl the site; the pages it had are kept meanwhile.

tags.title: Tags
tags.description: Given to the pages it stores.

file_id.title: File Id
file_id.description: The document to study; it must be processed.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: `summary`: key points in the document's order. `flashcards`: a question or term on the front, its answer on the back. `quiz`: multiple-choice questions with four choices, the right one and why.

items.title: Items
items.description: Of the requested kind; each cites the passages it comes from. Empty when the model wrote nothing usable.

chunks.title: Chunks
chunks.description: Chunks of the document: more than `passages` when the document is longer than the model reads at once, and only chunks spread over it were used.

page.title: Page
page.description: Page number for PDFs, starting at 1; null otherwise.

section.title: Section
section.description: The headings above the passage, when known.

files.title: Files
files.description: How many of the project's files have it.

period_start.title: Period Start
period_start.description: Start of the calendar month (UTC) counted.

requests_per_minute.title: Requests Per Minute
requests_per_minute.description: The rate limit; null when unlimited.

answers.description: Answers this month, and the monthly quota.

storage_bytes.description: Bytes of files stored now, and the limit.

input_tokens.title: Input Tokens
input_tokens.description: Prompt tokens of this month's answers.

cost_usd.title: Cost Usd
cost_usd.description: Known cost of this month's answers, in US dollars.

budget_usd.title: Budget Usd
budget_usd.description: The monthly budget, in US dollars; null when there is none. Asking is refused once `cost_usd` reaches it.

start.title: Start
start.description: Start of the first day counted (UTC).

days.title: Days
days.description: Every day, oldest first; days without answers have zeros.

projects.title: Projects
projects.description: Projects with answers in the period, costliest first.

input_tokens.title: Input Tokens
input_tokens.description: Prompt tokens; 0 when the model was not called, null when the provider did not report them.

output_tokens.title: Output Tokens
output_tokens.description: Tokens the model wrote, as for input_tokens.

cost_usd.title: Cost Usd
cost_usd.description: US dollars; null when the usage or the model's prices (LLM_*_PRICE_PER_MILLION) are unknown.

secret.title: Secret
secret.description: Signs every delivery; shown only now, so keep it.

url.title: Url
url.description: Where to POST events: an http or https URL.

question.title: Question
examples: What do my notes say about overlap?

conversation_id.title: Conversation Id
conversation_id.description: The visitor's conversation, from an earlier answer; omit to start one.

logo_url.title: Logo Url
logo_url.description: The image in its header, if any.

WidgetConfigResponse.title: WidgetConfigResponse
WidgetConfigResponse.description: What the widget shows; nothing about the tenant or its project.

name.title: Name
name.description: Shown in the widget's header, e.g. the assistant's name.

welcome.title: Welcome
welcome.description: The first message visitors see, before they ask.
examples: Hi! Ask me anything about our employee handbook.

accent.title: Accent
accent.description: The widget's colour, as #rrggbb; #2563eb when omitted.

allowed_origins.title: Allowed Origins
allowed_origins.description: The websites that may embed the widget, as origins such as `https://example.com` (scheme, host and any port; no path), or `*` for any website.

tags.title: Tags
tags.description: Answer only from files with any of these tags; [] for all files.

logo_url.title: Logo Url
logo_url.description: An https URL of an image shown in the widget's header (square, at least 64 pixels); null for none.
